documentTypes.label: IRS Form 990 (or 990-EZ / 990-N)
documentTypes.description: Annual information return filed with the IRS by chapters with a foundation or 501(c)(3) status. Upload the accepted filing.

documentTypes.label: Chapter Financial Audit
documentTypes.description: Most recent chapter audit. Per Chapman criteria 1.6, the audit may not be older than 120 days past the end of the fraternal year.

documentTypes.label: Chapter Foundation 501(c)(3) Filing

documentTypes.label: Special Event Checklist
documentTypes.description: Completed special event planning and compliance checklist (format TBD — framework placeholder).

documentTypes.label: Special Event After-Action Report
documentTypes.description: Post-event report submitted after a special event (format TBD — framework placeholder).
